profile_text.body:
Ambarella describes itself as a maker of AI vision processors for edge applications. According to its site, its imaging solutions are intended to make cameras smarter by extracting data from high-resolution video streams. The company names advanced driver assistance systems, smart electronic mirrors, drive recorders, and autonomous vehicles among the uses it addresses.

The company is a for-profit public company headquartered in Santa Clara, California, trading under the ticker AMBA, with CIK 0001280263.

Its recorded legal exposure is in California, with a count of 281. No individual cases are listed, and no products or MCP servers are tracked.
